name: better-scholar
description: Chrome extension for Google Scholar profiles: highlights each paper's author role (first / last…) and shows its CCF / CORE venue rank, with a role × rank summary.

paragraphs: Supercharge Google Scholar. Author roles, CCF & CORE ranks, awards, citation totals, and search with operators — with zero dependencies.
Website (30 languages) · 简体中文 · Install · Key features · Search operators · How it works · Copy and export · For AI agents · Privacy
features: No dependencies, no build step. Load src/ as an unpacked extension.

Precision first. The venue matcher has no fuzzy or substring fallback. A venue it cannot place gets no badge and is listed in the panel; every badge's tooltip names the matched venue, the rule that matched and the…
Authorship roles. First, co-first (a leading group of authors that share a mark such as or †), second and last author. Your name is marked in the author line, with your position in a tooltip.
Awards and talks. A bundled list of 7,830 paper awards taken from official award pages, plus the Oral / Spotlight / Highlight labels authors write themselves.
Citation totals. Papers, citations, h-index and i10-index of your highlighted papers next to those of all papers. The h-index and i10-index buttons list the highlighted papers behind the number.

requirements.text: No account, no analytics, no tracking.
